Core Features and Gameplay
Game Modes: Features solo battles, a 2-player local mode, a football mini-game, survival, and a challenging Boss Fight Tournament.
Customization and Creation: Includes a map editor for custom arenas alongside unlockable character skins and custom equipment.
Weapons and Gear: Combat utilizes a wide array of weapons, including katanas, daggers, scythes, hammers, bows, and novelty items like ice cream and guitars.
Physics Settings: Players can adjust match modifiers like gravity, energy shields, and instant KO rules.
Platforms: Available on mobile platforms (iOS and Android via app stores and web browsers).
